SPORTS AND RECREATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: SPORTS AND RECREATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Exercise and Nutrition requirements: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Exercise and Nutrition requirements.
   B. Practise Exercise and Nutrition requirements with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Exercise and Nutrition requirements.
   D. Damage equipment used for Exercise and Nutrition requirements.

3. Best practice when working on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Basic Elements of Sports Coaching with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   C. Damage equipment used for Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.

4. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

5. Best practice when working on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   C. Practise Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.

6. Best practice when working on Game officials: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Game officials.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Game officials.
   C. Damage equipment used for Game officials.
   D. Practise Game officials with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression.

8. Best practice when working on Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W.
   B. Damage equipment used for Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W.
   C. Practise Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W.

9. Best practice when working on Tactical Skills and Formations: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Tactical Skills and Formations with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Tactical Skills and Formations.
   C. Damage equipment used for Tactical Skills and Formations.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Tactical Skills and Formations.

10. Best practice when working on Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III.
   C. Damage equipment used for Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III.

11. Best practice when working on Management of Sports Activities: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Management of Sports Activities.
   B. Damage equipment used for Management of Sports Activities.
   C. Practise Management of Sports Activities with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Management of Sports Activities.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Exercise and Nutrition requirements and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Basic Elements of Sports Coaching and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Practise Exercise and Nutrition requirements with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Basic Elements of Sports Coaching with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Red, blue, and yellow

5. C — Practise Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Game officials with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Tactical Skills and Formations with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
